info.name: Web APIs
info.description: Admin dashboard and employee dashboard APIs. Admin routes use {{admin_token}}; employee routes use {{employee_token}}. Every request uses Accept-Language: {{accept_language}}; switch between en and ar to compare localized lookup, complaint, report, and classification display text.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Admin and employee web authentication flow. Copy OTPs from Mailtrap/email into admin_otp or employee_otp.

request.description:
Purpose: Start admin login and send OTP by email.
Required role: public
Required token: none
Expected response: standard GCMS API envelope with success, message, data, and meta when present.

exec: pm.test('status code is 200 or 201', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('response has success key', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('success'); });
var json = pm.response.json();
function getPath(obj, path) { return path.split('.').reduce(function (current, key) { return current && current[key] !== undefined ? current[key] : undefined; }, obj); }

[["data.user_id","data.user.id"]].flat().some(function (path) { var value = getPath(json, path); if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') { pm.environment.set('admin_user_id', value); return true; } return false; });

request.description:
Purpose: List employee-only records for complaint assignment. `/admin/users` lists all roles; this endpoint remains the employee lookup for assignment UI. Optional filters: search, department_id, is_active, page, and per_page (maximum 100).
Required role: admin
Required token: {{admin_token}}
Expected response: standard GCMS paginated API envelope. Saves the first returned employee id to {{employee_id}}.

exec: pm.test('status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var json = pm.response.json();
pm.test('response is successful', function () { pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('employees is an array', function () { pm.expect(json.data.employees).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('pagination meta exists', function () { pm.expect(json.meta).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('returned records are employees', function () { json.data.employees.forEach(function (employee) { pm.expect(employee.role).to.eql('employee'); }); });
if (json.data.employees.length > 0) { pm.environment.set('employee_id', json.data.employees[0].id); }

item.name: Admin User Management
item.description: Admin-only provisioning and lifecycle management. `PATCH /admin/users/{user}` updates safe profile, role, and department fields only; activation and deactivation use the dedicated `/status` endpoint.

exec: pm.test('status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var json = pm.response.json();
pm.test('users response is successful', function () { pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.users).to.be.an('array'); });
if (json.data.users.length > 0) { pm.environment.set('user_id', json.data.users[0].id); }
pm.test('status code is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
var json = pm.response.json();
pm.test('employee is created', function () { pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.user.role).to.eql('employee'); });
if (json.data.user.id) { pm.environment.set('user_id', json.data.user.id); pm.environment.set('employee_id', json.data.user.id); }
pm.test('status code is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
var json = pm.response.json();
pm.test('admin is created', function () { pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.user.role).to.eql('admin'); });
if (json.data.user.id) { pm.environment.set('user_id', json.data.user.id); }
pm.test('status code is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
var json = pm.response.json();
pm.test('citizen is created', function () { pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.user.role).to.eql('citizen'); });
if (json.data.user.id) { pm.environment.set('user_id', json.data.user.id); }
pm.test('status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('user response is successful', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.user).to.have.property('id'); });
pm.test('status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('user update is successful', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.user).to.have.property('id'); });
pm.test('status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var json = pm.response.json();
pm.test('status update is successful', function () { pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.user).to.have.property('is_active'); });
